messages:
maya: Heads-up: nightly retrieval eval for RAG showed a ~12% drop in recall on the latest run vs yesterday. Affects longtail/recency queries. :eyes:
jun: saw it too in the dashboard — spike starts around 03:10 UTC in the nightly job. link: https://grafana.redwood/graph?panel=recall_nightly (private)
soren: any recent changes to indexing or segmenting? sounds like stale vectors or missing docs on search side
maya: we rolled indexer v2.1.4 last week (shard-merge change). Noticed compaction backlog but assumed it settled.
eva: can you paste the failing example queries?
maya: yep — one failing query and topk before/after:
````
query: "How to rotate API keys for a service account?"
expected top doc id: doc_8a1f
last night topk: doc_8a1f present
this morning topk: doc_8a1f missing, replaced with unrelated doc_4b2c
````
jun: that feels like the vector for doc_8a1f didn't get merged into the live index shard. Could be a propagation lag or a merge transaction skip
indexer-bot: INFO 2025-06-12T03:05:22Z segment-merge started shard=7 seg_from=seg_20250612_02 seg_to=seg_20250612_03
indexer-bot: WARN 2025-06-12T03:07:10Z merge skipped due to checksum mismatch shard=7 seg_id=seg_20250612_03
soren: checksum mismatch -> could explain missing vectors if the segment was skipped and never retried
eva: are there any retry jobs or dead-letter queue entries?
indexer-bot: DLQ enqueue count at 03:08 UTC increased by 84 for shard=7. Oldest DLQ item ts=2025-06-12T02:59:11Z
jun: checking S3 ingestion commits...
jun: `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-vecs/commits/ | tail -n 20` shows commit seg_20250612_03 uploaded at 03:02 but `index-commit-manifest` shows status=unverified for that commit
maya: interesting — nightly eval hits a read-replica in us-west which may be lagging behind write-replica if compaction not applied
soren: putting hypothesis: 1) merge job failed checksum, 2) no retry, 3) serving nodes didn't see the segment, 4) queries miss the vectors -> recall drop
eva: workaround? can we force a re-merge or promote a fresh snapshot to read-replicas
infra-bot: runbook snippet: `./infra indexer retry-commit --shard=7 --commit=seg_20250612_03`
jun: I ran a dry-run of the retry and it looks like the retry pipeline is rate-limited to 5/s and there is a backlog. Starting a manual immediate remerge for shard 7
soren: while that's running, we should invalidate the prefixes cache for affected docs to avoid stale KV hits. `curl -X POST https://cache.redwood/internal/invalidate -d '{"prefix":"docs:shard7:"}'`
maya: command output after manual remerge:
````
$ ./indexer force-merge --shard=7 --commit=seg_20250612_03 --force
force merge: started
merge: completed with warnings: checksum-mismatch-fixed
promoted commit -> live index
````
eva: running quick eval smoke on a sample of failing queries...
eva: result: recall back to baseline for the sample (10/10 recovered) :thumbsup:
maya: full nightly rerun queued; should finish in ~12m
indexer-bot: INFO 2025-06-12T03:20:45Z replication: snapshot promoted to replicas shard=7 version=20250612T03
jun: doing quick audit to confirm no other shards with skipped merges. scanning commit manifests for status=unverified or skipped
jun: found 3 other commits across shards 2,4,9 with the same checksum-mismatch pattern between 02:58-03:12 UTC
soren: ok escalate: likely bug in v2.1.4 that occasionally corrupts segment upload checksums when compaction runs concurrently with node-restarts.
eva: next steps?
maya: short term: retry all unverified commits, force-promote if remerge fixes checksums. owners: @soren for indexer, @jun for replication/replicas, @maya to follow evals.
soren: I'll add a hotfix branch to make merges atomic (avoid partial uploads) and increase DLQ alerts. Will also add a retry-with-backoff measurement.
jun: I'll add a temporary increase to retry rate and manually clear backlog for the next 6 hours. Also will add a replication lag alarm to catch read-replica stale windows.
eva: add an integration test to nightly that simulates seg-upload checksum mismatch and validates retry path (so this failure mode is covered)
maya: assigned follow-ups in ticket: https://issues.redwood/ML-1129 (internal) — include the eval diff and the sample failing queries
infra-bot: deploy notice: indexer v2.1.5 (hotfix) scheduled to canary at 05:00 UTC
jun: watchlist: replication lag, DLQ count, nightly recall. I'll post updates in this thread.
maya: thanks all — will post final postmortem if the rerun stabilizes. :heart:
